Supreme Court Restrains CBI Action Against Punjab CM Aide

The Supreme Court has ordered that no coercive action be taken against Rajbir Singh Ghuman, an Officer on Special Duty (OSD) linked to the Punjab government and Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, in a corruption case being investigated by the CBI. While the FIR against Ghuman remains in place, the court has barred the CBI from pursuing coercive measures against him.
